name: mtl-culture-hub
//domain: rendered from $HOME/.claude/skills/spec-init/domains/fullstack/domain.json; all = both skill sets on the transformation lifecycle
//seed: compass-app-template@68e19daa3a6c60c5082723a16ba12da603b9db46; set by item 13, appended to by a second seed
//lifecycleRoles: which lifecycle status plays which part in the loop. The core skills bind these instead of naming a status, so one set of skills runs a dev lifecycle and a document lifecycle. start = work begun (/spec-start); review = awaiting review (/spec-start ends here); test = integrated and verified on the integration branch (/spec-test; null when the lifecycle has no such hop); done = terminal (/spec-ship). A stage with no role is walked by /spec-review.

docs.//buildCommand: the project's own generator. /docs-build runs exactly this string and nothing else; null means docs/ is hand-written and there is no generator to run.

branding.//theme: the client slug naming a Compass Design Library theme overlay: tools/docs-site/src/themes/<slug>.css for the viewers, src/themes/<slug>.css for the app. It is an overlay on the CDL shell, applied as html[data-theme="<slug>"], never a replacement for it. null means the CDL default tokens, synced by npm run sync:cdl.
branding.//logo: path to the client logo the sidebar logo slot renders, repo-relative. null means the sidebar falls back to an initials badge.
branding.//accent: legacy alias kept so pre-theme configs keep working. theme wins when both are set; do not add accent to a new config.

//standards: Compass standards mirrored into docs/reference/ by tools/standards/sync.mjs from compassanalytics/compass-standards, pinned to one commit so the project can say which version it was held to. /standards-sync re-pins and refreshes; a mirrored file is never edited by hand.
